analysis.insight_summary: User encountered a failure when attempting to download a project from their PC to [product_name] after updating [product_name] Soft Comfort to [version_no]. The issue is specific to certain [product_name] hardware versions and appeared immediately after a software upgrade, suggesting a possible compatibility or configuration problem following the update. The core concern is the unexpected interruption and failed program transfer after the upgrade, making it difficult for the user to carry out their regular programming workflow.
